title: Halong Bay Heritage Marathon 2026 Review: What the 2025 Edition Was Like
seo_title: Halong Bay Heritage Marathon 2026 Review | Ha Long
meta_description: Halong Bay Heritage Marathon review: a 2:13:57 course record in November 2025, a World Athletics Label, and a fully closed coastal course in Ha Long.
dek: Vietnam's only World Athletics Label road race set a new course record in November 2025. Here is what that edition was like, ahead of the 11th edition in November 2026.
verdict: The Halong Bay Heritage Marathon is Vietnam's only road race with a World Athletics Label, which it has held for two years running [1]. In the 2025 edition, Kennedy Kiprop Chelimo won the marathon in 2:13:57, a course record [1]. The course starts and finishes at the Quang Ninh planning and exhibition centre on the coastal road in Ha Long, and is fully closed to traffic in both directions [1]. The organisers expect about 18,000 runners for the 11th edition, on Sunday 22 November 2026 [1]. If you want a certified, fast marathon on a closed coastal course in Vietnam, this is a strong option.

sections.heading: The 2025 Edition
paragraphs: In the 2025 season, Kennedy Kiprop Chelimo ran the marathon in 2:13:57, breaking the race record [1]. The race retained its World Athletics Label for a second consecutive year, and remains the only road race in Vietnam to hold one [1].
There were four distances: the marathon, half marathon, 10 km and 5 km [1].

sections.heading: The Course
paragraphs: The start and finish are at the Quang Ninh Province Planning, Fair and Exhibition Palace on the Tran Quoc Nghien coastal road in Ha Long [1]. The course is fully closed in both directions [1], and the organisers say it has been ranked among the 50 most beautiful running courses in the world [1].
For 2026, the organisers say they will further upgrade medical and rescue cover, course safety and doping control to keep the World Athletics Label standard [1].

sections.heading: Should You Enter the 2026 Race?
paragraphs: Yes, if you want a fast, certified marathon in northern Vietnam on a closed course by the sea. A 2:13 course record shows how quick the course can be.
The race is growing quickly, with 18,000 runners and 5,000 to 6,000 international athletes expected in 2026 [1], so book travel to Ha Long early.
This review is compiled from the organisers' published account of the race and its 2025 results. It is not a first-hand race report, and nobody from this site ran the race.

faqs.question: What is the Halong Bay Heritage Marathon course record?
faqs.answer: 2:13:57, set by Kennedy Kiprop Chelimo in the 2025 marathon. The race has a World Athletics Label, the only road race in Vietnam to hold one, which it retained for a second year in 2025.

faqs.question: Where does the Halong Bay Heritage Marathon start?
faqs.answer: At the Quang Ninh Province Planning, Fair and Exhibition Palace on the Tran Quoc Nghien coastal road in Ha Long. The course is fully closed to traffic in both directions.

faqs.question: When is the Halong Bay Heritage Marathon 2026?
faqs.answer: The race weekend runs from 20 to 22 November 2026, with race day on Sunday 22 November. It will be the 11th edition, and the organisers expect about 18,000 runners over the marathon, half marathon, 10 km and 5 km.
